note: In-game Cookbook (David's videos, 31 Oct 2026). 73 recipes. The list shows discovered dishes first, then the undiscovered ones by method; an undiscovered dish shows only its method, a silhouette and three '?' ingredient slots. Counts read frame by frame: 16 discovered + 18 Grilling, 20 Boiling, 19 Slicing undiscovered. The discovered ones fall in the same method order (7 Grilling, 6 Boiling, 3 Slicing), giving 25 Grilling, 26 Boiling, 22 Slicing (method of Assorted..., Potato Pizza and Grilled Cla... inferred from that order; not seen opened). Names cut off by the game ('...') are kept as shown.
rules: 3 slots, one ingredient each: a recipe uses 1-3 ingredients.

Each slot has a fixed list of substitutes (the swap icon on the slot opens 'Materials to change'); it is not simply the whole category: Meat Stew's Boar Meat slot offered only Beast Meat, though Fox Meat and Aged Game Meat were in the inventory.
Dish stars follow the ingredients' stars (up to 5): 3x Boar Meat (4 stars) -> 5-star Meat Stew; 3x Bird Eggs (2 stars) -> 3-star Hard-boiled Egg, 3x Goose Eggs (3 stars) -> 4-star.
Cooking an unknown combination discovers the dish: Round Eggplant + Shrimp Flesh + Bird Meat, Grilling -> Steak Set Meal (3 stars, Recovery).
Effect badges in the list: red + = Recovery, green sword = Attack (team buffs), teal = Familiar stamina, pink = revive.
